name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Cirq program computing linear cross-e
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Cirq program computing linear cross-entropy benchmarking (XEB) fidelity of random single-qubit-rotation + CZ circuits on 3 qubits, depth 13, comparing a noiseless sampler against the ideal probabilities (expected XEB ≈ 1). Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
